description: This file defines a lock-free multi-producer multi-consumer queue template class with aligned storage and custom allocators, including detailed implementation of enqueue and dequeue operations, designed for high-performance concurrent scenarios.
external_files: depending on platform, for aligned memory allocation

classes.name: AlignedAllocator
classes.description: Custom allocator for aligned memory allocation, using platform-specific aligned malloc/free.

classes.name: Slot
classes.description: Represents a slot in the queue with storage for an element and a turn indicator for synchronization.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A lock-free, multi-producer, multi-consumer concurrent queue with fixed capacity.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory for T elements.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory allocated for T elements.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in the slot with provided arguments.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the object of type T in the slot.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the object of type T out of the slot.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the queue with perfect forwarding of arguments.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Inserts a copy or move of the element into the queue.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to insert a copy or move of the element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes an element from the queue.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to remove an element from the queue without blocking.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the approximate number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.
